reason: Adds a Web settings panel for listing archived conversations and restoring or permanently deleting them through host-side REST operations and session storage updates.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 设置中提供归档会话列表，并支持恢复会话或永久删除其存储日志。
summaries.en: Adds a Web settings page for viewing archived conversations and restoring or permanently deleting their stored session logs.

capabilities: Adds an Archived sessions settings page
Lists archived conversations grouped by folder
Restores archived sessions by updating archive state
Permanently deletes stored session logs from disk
Registers REST operations for restore and deletion
